name: 0.1.0-beta.8
notes:
# Folian 0.1.0 beta 8

This release replaces the withdrawn Beta 7 build with a corrected macOS update check and the independently verified release packaging safeguards introduced during Beta 7.

- Adds Folian > Check for Updates so writers can check the beta update feed directly.
- Reports the installed release as up to date without asking Squirrel.Mac to download the same version again.
- Makes update checking, availability, download, and failure states clearer.
- Refines AI model choices into recommended, advanced, and older supported groups.
- Verifies DMG and updater ZIP contents locally and after GitHub download before feed publication.

Application updates replace only Folian itself. Your projects, encrypted provider keys, exports, backups, and local settings remain in Folian's separate data folder.
